title: Carried over: Schöningen wooden spears
summary: Wooden hunting spears preserved in a German lake deposit, made by an earlier human population. Usually dated 337,000-300,000 years ago; a 2025 study argues they are about 200,000 years old.
why: Shows earlier humans crafted wooden weapons for hunting big game.

notes.problem: Source: 'a 2025 study suggested an even younger age of approximately 200,000 years ago'; at that age 'predates our species' fails, so the date is debated.
